name: car_desk
tips: Ghante mein ek baar 2 minute khade hokar stretch kijiye
Bottle saamne rakhiye aur ghoont-ghoont peete rahiye

Phone aaye to khade hokar ya tehalte hue baat kijiye
Khaate waqt mobile aur laptop band, dhyan se khaiye
Kursi mein peeche tak baithiye, paon zameen par rakhiye
